findings.evidence: The new signature is `integrable_norm_mul_of_memLp_two {U V : α → ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n} (hU : MemLp U 2 μ) (hV : MemLp V 2 μ)`; Mathlib already has `MemLp.norm` at `Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSeminorm/Basic.lean:732` and Hölder product integrability `MemLp.integrable_mul` at `Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/L1Space/Integrable.lean:1085` backed by `MemLp.mul` at `CompareExp.lean:320`.
findings.fix: Do not add this as a public PDE lemma; inline the derivation in `integrable_energyIntegrand_apply₂_of_memLp_two` using `hU.norm`/`hV.norm` and `MemLp.integrable_mul`, or state a genuinely general helper over arbitrary normed codomains if TauCeti needs one.
findings.issue: `integrable_norm_mul_of_memLp_two` is a public PDE-specific special case of the general Mathlib `MemLp` product API, restricted to jets and exponent `2`.

summary: One public helper is at the wrong API level: it packages a general Hölder/Mathlib fact as a PDE-specific jet lemma.
